description: AGSC-11-20 as amended for 1.1: a restricted node sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header on any artefact other than the discovery document, so a deployment profile for a host that adds the wildcard by default overrides it. Derivation: for each of the paths below, the header set a restricted node's writer states carries neither Access-Control-Allow-Origin nor Access-Control-Expose-Headers, and no credentials header either (bnd-0001 states the wildcard for a public node, bnd-0002 the discovery document of a restricted one). The case states no header that must be present.
